text.en:
As Magazine goes below #e${50+#d}%, until empty: 
<pve [PVE] 12.1% to 25.6% Increased damage. />
<pvp [PVP] 3% to 6% Increased damage. />

Activation is based on the Base Magazine Capacity so it's unaffected by overflowing effects. 

enhanced (
var d = 7.85
#e Activates with 7.85% more of the Magazine Capacity remaining.
)
